en: A black-and-white photo of a formal meeting or conference, likely from the early to mid-20th century. The room is filled with well-dressed men in suits seated at tables covered with white tablecloths. The room has high ceilings, ornate molding, and large windows letting in natural light. There are papers, folders, and ashtrays on the tables, and a painting can be seen on the far wall.
